They then meet inside what appears to be the Oval Office, shaking hands again. The video shows close-ups of both men as they talk. This is followed by a shot of a pen with Trump's signature on it, lying on a document. Both men are then shown sitting at a large desk, with American flags in the background, signing documents. They hold up the signed documents for the camera, smiling, and shake hands one more time. The video concludes with a black and white shot of a helicopter followed by a shot of the White House, with the text 'THE WHITE HOUSE' overlaid.
